text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hi there, Goddesses! ♪ How are you
doing?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You called me here, right? I heard your
voices.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Did you have some business with me?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Strange... I could've sworn I heard a
voice just
now.
